name: IrixClassic GTK
author: mrmmx31
kind: Local GTK2/3/4 translation of this repository's Classic reconstruction
adaptations: Native GTK CSS nodes and GTK2 pixmap drawing functions replace Kvantum IDs.
Keyboard focus uses GTK dotted outlines and the Classic input focus rim.
GTK switches are square GTK-specific adaptations; GTK2 has no switch widget.
GTK4 scrollbars have no steppers; persistent 18px troughs and grips are styled.
GTK3/4 tabs retain native rectangular geometry and Classic integer bevels.
CSS/gtkrc inherits each profile's gtk-font-name, with italic menu titles and no bundled font.
Disabled indicators map the local colored marks to gray; native GTK2 can emboss disabled text.
Hover on command buttons is visually inert; native menu/list locate feedback remains immediate.
historical_claim: Independent reconstruction and toolkit adaptation, no universal IRIX pixel-identity claim
